note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 8669 Section 3.1 ('RESERVED: 8-bit field. It MUST be clear on transmission'). Verified attribute.EncodePrefixSID and parsePrefixSIDWithSRGB (internal/core/bgp/attribute/prefixsid.go) emit Reserved=0, and session_prefix_sid.go::clearLabelIndexTLVs (invoked by session_egress_normalize.go::normalizeTransmittedUpdate) zeroes bytes [3:6] of type-1 Label-Index TLVs on IPv4/IPv6 labeled unicast while preserving unrecognized TLVs on other families. Positives assert exact zero Reserved on bare and SRGB-form encoders (TestRFC8669LabelIndexTLVReservedAndFlagsClearOnTransmission, TestRFC8669SRGBFormLabelIndexReservedAndFlagsClearOnTransmission), family-gated egress clearing on IPv4/IPv6 LU regardless of attribute order (TestClearTransmittedLabelIndexOnlyOnLabeledUnicast), and clean transmission across all 6 writer/relay rails (TestRFC8669LabelIndexTransmissionClearsReservedAndFlags). Negative sends dirty Reserved=0xa5 across all 6 rails and asserts exact cleared wire bytes without mutating borrowed source or Originator SRGB. Q1-Q4 pass.
